Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.goals

Interface MannequinGoal

All Known Implementing Classes:
AttackGoal, LookAtPlayerGoal, NearestPlayerTargetGoal, WanderGoal
public interface MannequinGoal
The contract every mannequin goal must satisfy.

The lifecycle mirrors vanilla's Goal class:

  1. canUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) is polled each tick while the goal is inactive.
  2. When canUse returns true the selector calls start(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) and the goal becomes active.
  3. Every subsequent tick the selector calls tick(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) while the goal is active, then checks canContinueToUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin).
  4. When canContinueToUse returns false (or a higher-priority goal interrupts), the selector calls stop(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) and the goal returns to inactive.

Implement isInterruptable() to control whether a running goal can be replaced mid-execution by a higher-priority one.

  • Method Details

    • getKey

      GoalKey getKey()
      Returns the unique key for this goal. Used by GoalSelector for lookup and removal.
      Returns:
      this goal's GoalKey

    • getType

      GoalType getType()
      Returns the category this goal belongs to. Register normal goals with the normal selector and target goals with the target selector — mixing them is a logic error.
      Returns:
      this goal's GoalType

    • canUse

      boolean canUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called every tick while this goal is inactive. Return true when the conditions required to start this goal are met.
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this goal is attached to
      Returns:
      true if the goal should start

    • canContinueToUse

      default boolean canContinueToUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called every tick while this goal is active, after tick(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin). Return false to signal that the goal has finished and stop(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) should be called.

      Defaults to delegating to canUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) — override if the condition for continuing differs from the condition for starting (e.g. you want to keep targeting even if no new target would be selected).

      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this goal is attached to
      Returns:
      true to keep running

    • start

      default void start(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called once when this goal transitions from inactive → active. Use this to initialize per-run state (timers, cached targets, etc.).
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this goal is attached to

    • stop

      default void stop(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Called once when this goal transitions from active → inactive, whether because canContinueToUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) returned false or because a higher-priority goal interrupted it. Use this to clean up per-run state.
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this goal is attached to

    • tick

      default void tick(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)

      Parameters:

    • isInterruptable

      default boolean isInterruptable()
      Whether a currently running instance of this goal can be interrupted by a higher-priority goal that also wants to run.

      Return false to make the goal "sticky" — it will run to completion even if a higher-priority goal becomes eligible.

      Returns:
      true if the goal is interruptable (default)
